verdict.increment: Bounded review of the shared-weight MTP startup/profile increment only; qualification_increment remains 0.
actual_inspected_scope: The startup script, base and long Compose configuration, and launcher tests.
The pinned llama.cpp source excerpt at ref 091b6a7fc, blob c5043a4a83e30398a07291401dc68bbcc52d5c91.

Returned archived positive and negative artifacts for long-profile-v5 and shared-mtp-launcher-v1, including runtime identity, capacity, memory, local/API checks, task records, and generated documents.
checks: Startup defaults to draft-mtp without passing a separate draft model or draft GPU-layer setting; an explicit MTP_MODEL_PATH adds both settings. The POSIX launcher tests also cover a path containing spaces, SPEC_TYPE=none, and rejection of an unknown type.
The pinned source excerpt initializes the MTP draft context from model_tgt using params.model.path. Its ref matches the runtime build suffix 091b6a7fc in the returned runtime records.

The archived default runtime record reports the expected pinned inference image, build b11610-091b6a7fc, mounted-startup hash match, shared-context log confirmation, and no separate draft load observed.

The bounded long-profile case records shared-target MTP, context 69888, draft tokens 2, and ubatch 32. Its synthetic 65536-token input plus 4096-token generation reached the recorded limit without truncation. Three archived native Claude tasks passed their recorded parent checks.

The long-profile memory record reports a 13111 MiB conservative sampled whole-host delta, within its stated 14,000,000,000-byte limit. It explicitly identifies desktop drift and unsampled transients as confounds and does not claim isolated allocation residency.

The preserved shared-mtp-launcher-v1 one-shot has a negative operator-guide result: it lacks the required up -d --build command, includes an unexpected up -d command, and omits the request-anchor policy. The separate bounded-feedback operator-guide result passes after one repair; this does not repair or replace the archived one-shot failure.

The returned launcher/check output reports 31 passing tests. The positive API artifacts include local text/tool continuation and OpenAI schema/output-limit checks; these are bounded checks, not general model-quality evidence.
findings: The startup change and explicit separate-draft argument construction are supported by source inspection and launcher tests. Separate-draft compatibility is not established as a live runtime case by the returned evidence.
The newer bounded operator result and the older failed one-shot are distinct records and should remain represented as such.

Some archived generated documents describe the default 40960 context or older VRAM snapshots. They are not proof of the long profile's effective context or its measured memory; the specific runtime and capacity records support those bounded claims instead.
limits: No inference of universal model correctness, general task quality, or information-retention parity from task passes.
Sampled whole-host occupancy is not isolated per-allocation GPU residency.
This review does not close remaining Codex or full-goal gates. Full goal remains NOT_READY.
